gates.evidence: need, users, rights, no-AI equivalent and year-round asset passport
gates.stop_if: no real problem owner or lawful rights route

gates.evidence: conversion rehearsal, storage, shutdown and restoration record
gates.stop_if: conversion, storage, access or emergency stop fails rehearsal

gates.evidence: duty roster, incident log, complaints and physical alternatives
gates.stop_if: no named human duty manager or safe physical alternative

gates.evidence: restored route, daily schedule, inventory and named handover
gates.stop_if: event equipment blocks daily service or has no steward

gates.evidence: use, repair, complaint, spend and remedy summary
gates.stop_if: evidence cannot be independently read or remedies remain open

gates.evidence: joint keep/change/retire decision with reasons and next budget
gates.stop_if: no continuing public use, maintenance resource or accountable steward
